cells.note: Broker-dealer and ATS comparator · United States
cells.detail: tZERO supplies a useful venue, access and digital-security operating comparator with a distinct ATS legal route.

sources.label: SEC settled order concerning tZERO ATS
tZERO funding round for tokenized-market infrastructure

cells.note: Role in the SEC order: conditional candidate

cells.text: tZERO announced a September 14 financing round to advance its tokenized-market infrastructure-as-a-service offering and support a possible strategic transaction.
cells.detail: Where the proof stops: Funding and strategic intent do not establish a new operating route, eligible-security cohort, transaction volume or completed corporate transaction.

cells.text: Venue + operator (capability); Access + identity (capability); Post-trade completion (support)
items: Venue + operator · Operator identity, Venue authority, Participant rules: A registered ATS is a live venue comparator but not the new exempt venue category.
Access + identity · Admission / KYC: Broker-dealer onboarding and eligibility sit in the access layer.
Post-trade completion · Custody, Securities settlement: Product-specific custody and settlement providers remain separate actors.

cells.text: ATS operation is not TSV exemption reliance. The SEC's 2022 settled order remains part of the regulatory record and current product pages do not establish an Innovation Exemption Notice.
cells.note: Watch: Exact operating entity, current ATS disclosures, eligible instruments, custody and clearing path, any TSV Notice and remediation receipts.
